## configureCanvasForDevicePixelRatio() function

Sizes a `<canvas>` element's backing store for `devicePixelRatio` (so it isn't blurry on HiDPI screens) while keeping its CSS/layout size at `cssWidth`<!-- -->x`cssHeight`<!-- -->, and returns a 2D context pre-scaled so drawing code can keep working in CSS pixels.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function configureCanvasForDevicePixelRatio(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, cssWidth: number, cssHeight: number, devicePixelRatio: number): CanvasRenderingContext2D | null;
```
